title: MuJo tool-calling development evaluations: corrected adapter attribution

provenance.source: Four aggregate evaluation summaries reread from completed LUMI evaluation job 23524785; job exit 0:0.
provenance.source_hashes: SHA-256 of original aggregate JSON bytes; no private prompts included.

correction: Earlier results labelled v5e3/v6 used the v5 adapter due to a stale adapter path. They must not be attributed to v5e3/v6. This report uses corrected adapter selection.

methodology.tool_ok: Includes heuristic multi-call and refusal scoring, not successful execution of tools.
methodology.args_exact: String comparison of expected argument values; additional argument fields are not necessarily penalized.
methodology.args_casefold: Lowercase and whitespace normalization only; formerly called args_sem. NOT semantic SQL equivalence.
methodology.parse_ok: Parser acceptance, not proof that tools executed.

limitations: Small development sets; not an independent held-out benchmark.
v6 examples were constructed after inspecting v24 errors; template and exact-prompt overlap may exist. Do not infer uncontaminated generalization.
v25 is format-sensitive and is not necessarily harder than v24.
v26 overlaps development/training families and must not be advertised as an independent holdout.
Train/validation splits may share templates and duplicated examples.
v6 improves v24 tool count by 5/63 but reduces v24 parse count by 3/63 and v25 tool count by 1/86; no statistical significance claim.
No production readiness, agent-task success, or autonomous-agent parallelism claim.

privacy.included: Aggregate counts and source-summary hashes only.
